name: registration-service
description: Owns seat capacity, registrations and waitlists for events and sessions, kept separate from the events API because the requirements isolate registration (P3). It confirms or waitlists a registration atomically against capacity, never over-allocating seats under simultaneous requests (P4), and promotes the next waitlisted person in first-come order inside the same request that frees a seat (cancel or capacity increase). It is called only by the events API; the web app never reaches it. It does not know about events, sessions, rooms or users beyond opaque ids, and runs no background jobs.
